propositions: The snapshot janitor's free-space trigger (DEFAULT_FREE_WATERMARK_BYTES = 2 GiB absolute) is disk-size-blind and on a 30-GiB volume reaches 93.3% used, above the 85% alarm floor and above the 90% peak reached during the incident.
Eviction did not engage anywhere from 71% to 90% used despite the janitor running every 300s, because the fixed 2-GiB floor crossed only at 93.3% used on this volume size.
The 7-day cold-trim exceeds the container's lifetime (23 recreations in 4 days) and the byte-total backstop promised by ADR 0005 is not implemented in _gc_pass.
Adding a volume-relative headroom term (free_watermark_pct as percent of total volume) with hysteresis allows reclaim to engage before the alarm floor on small volumes.
The trigger should be max(absolute_floor, pct_of_volume) and reclamation should target pct_of_volume + 5% margin to avoid re-firing every interval.
Defaulting free_watermark_pct to 0 preserves existing behavior; setting to 20 in compose makes the janitor engage at 80% used, below the 85% alarm threshold.
